Invest in Fish Network

Back the infrastructure connecting fund operations with investor trust.

Fish Network is building an operating platform where relevant fund activity creates a connected record for future assessment. The initial focus is Fish School deployments. The longer-term opportunity is a network of useful, attributable operating histories.

Fish Schools are the deployment model. Fish Protocol is the proposed record infrastructure. Fish Points adds participation and reputation context.

This page concerns investment in Fish Network, the company, not participation in a School.

Start an investor conversationRead the technical memo

The opportunity

Connect the system used to operate with the evidence used to evaluate.

Fund software helps teams execute workflows. Diligence asks investors to assess the people, decisions, and results behind them. Fish Network’s thesis is that these should be connected through the same operating history.

The proposition is not simply another collection of fund-management tools. It is a platform designed to preserve the relationship between an action, its source, and the records that support it.

Operational usefulness is the entry point. A credible, reusable history is the longer-term opportunity.

Start with Fish School deployments

Establish the operating relationship where the need is concrete.

The initial focus is organizers and emerging managers establishing investment groups and first vehicles. Fish Schools provide a defined setting in which to scope the workflows, responsibilities, and records the platform needs to support.

Existing managers can also explore fit. Supporting broader adoption requires a clear account of integration requirements, provider responsibilities, and the effort involved in changing an established setup.

The first test is whether a deployment is useful enough to become part of the firm’s operating process.

The value-building thesis

Earn the workflow. Build the history. Extend its usefulness.

01

Earn recurring use

Fundraising, decisions, capital activity, and reporting create recurring needs. The platform must serve those needs well enough to justify adoption.

02

Build useful historical context

Connected records can become more informative as the firm operates and outcomes emerge. Their value depends on coverage, accuracy, and source quality.

03

Earn recognition beyond the user

A wider advantage could develop if investors and providers find those records useful in their own assessments.

Adoption, retention, and external recognition are propositions to demonstrate. They are not presented here as established traction or a proven network effect.

Development and delivery

A scoped deployment path, with a broader architecture in development.

01

Current entry point

Deployment conversations establish the proposed use case, supported structure, provider responsibilities, and available implementation scope.

02

Operating platform

Fish School workflows are being developed around participant coordination, governance, capital activity, and reporting.

03

Protocol and reputation

The proposed architecture connects selected activity records with identity, capital, and participation context.

The team will distinguish available functionality, implementation dependencies, and planned capabilities in customer and investor discussions.

Beyond the first deployment

A more connected market for participation and evidence.

The broader vision is to connect investment groups, strategy providers, and relevant operating histories without treating every relationship as an isolated process.

The technical memo also explores potential pathways for eligible international investors to gain exposure to U.S. private-market assets. Those pathways remain subject to product development, appropriate structures, and jurisdictional review.
